scripts.build:windows: if not exist .env (copy .env.example .env) && docker compose up --build
scripts.old:build:windows: if not exist .env copy .env.example .env && if not exist backend-laravel\.env copy backend-laravel\.env.example backend-laravel\.env && docker compose up --build
scripts.old:build:other: ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env) && ([ -f backend-laravel/.env ] || cp backend-laravel/.env.example backend-laravel/.env) && docker compose up --build
scripts.setup:key: docker exec -it dele_go_backend php artisan key:generate
scripts.setup:migrate: docker exec -it dele_go_backend php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force
scripts.setup: npm run setup:composer && npm run setup:backend-npm && npm run setup:frontend-npm && npm run setup:key && npm run setup:migrate
